home_the_emulator_can_run_some_commercia: The emulator can run some commercial games!

home_ko_fi_page: If you would like to show your appreciation and even help fund development, the project has a Ko-fi Page.
home_meta_description: Vita3K is an experimental open-source Sony PlayStation Vita emulator for Windows, macOS, Linux and Android written in C++.
quickstart_get_started: Get started with Vita3K and play your favorite PSVita games!
quickstart_hardware_requirements_desc: The emulator performance and accuracy varies depending on your hardware. We cannot guarantee it will perform well if your PC barely meets the minimum requirements. For the best experience make sure you're within the recommended requirements as most of the reported games are tested with such requirements.
quickstart_x86_64_cpu_with_avx: x86_64 CPU with the AVX instruction set
quickstart_microsoft_redistributable_des: If you're having trouble running Vita3K and it complains about VCRUNTME140_1.dll was not found, download and install the Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable.
quickstart_operating_system_desc: You need to be running a 64-bit operating system in order for Vita3K to work.
quickstart_firmware_desc: Some games require the system modules be present for Vita3K to (low level) emulate them. This can be done by installing the PS Vita firmware through Vita3K.
quickstart_firmware_download: The firmware can be downloaded from the official PlayStation website.
quickstart_font_firmware_desc: There's also an additional firmware package that contains the system fonts that needs to be installed. The font firmware package can be downloaded straight from the PlayStation servers.
quickstart_could_not_get_url: But we couldn't get the URL for it, so you will have to find it yourself. Or in the discord server, using the -firmware command.
quickstart_install_both_firmware_package: Install both firmware packages using the File > Install Firmware menu option.
quickstart_managing_modules_desc: System modules can be managed in the Configuration > Settings > Core tab of the emulator, we recommend Modules Mode > Automatic. And if you have doubts some modules are causing crashes you can try to remove them.
quickstart_dumping_no_piracy: Vita3K does not condone piracy, therefore, you are required to dump your own games. Currently, it is preferred to dump your games on a Vita or Vita TV (PS TV) using HENkaku 3.60 - 3.65.
quickstart_dumping_supported_formats: Currently, Vita3K supports .pkg, VCI, NoNpDrm, FAGDec, or manually decrypted games (Vitamin dumps are not supported and Maidump is unstable). The games should be in a .zip, .vpk, or .vci format if you want to install them from the emulator, or if you prefer to copy them yourself, you can drag and drop the game folder in your vita_fs/ux0/app folder (not applicable for NoNpDrm dumps/.pkg/.vci files).
quickstart_dumping_how_to_desc: These are the several ways to dump and get decrypted games in order of their accuracy.
quickstart_vci_desc: VCI (Vita Cartridge Image) is a true 1:1 backup of a physical PS Vita game cartridge, including its authentication data. Because of this, it only works for cartridge games, not digital (PSN) games. It is the most accurate dumping method.
quickstart_vci_step_install: Install GcToolKit on your jailbroken PS Vita (or use its network backup companion app from your PC).
quickstart_vci_step_insert: Insert the game cartridge you want to dump into your Vita.
quickstart_vci_step_backup: Launch GcToolKit, choose to back up the entire game cart, and select VCI as the output format.
quickstart_vci_step_wait: Wait for the dump to finish. The resulting .vci file will be saved to your chosen storage device.
quickstart_vci_step_transfer: Transfer the .vci file to your PC.
quickstart_vci_step_archive: Use File -> Install Archive (.zip / .vpk / .vci) and select it. The game will begin installing.
quickstart_fagdec_step_download: Download Vitashell and FAGDec and install them to your PS Vita
quickstart_fagdec_step_cartridge: If you're dumping from a cartridge:
quickstart_fagdec_step_digital: If you're dumping a digital game:
quickstart_fagdec_step_digital_desc: Launch Vitashell and navigate to ux0:app (or wherever your games are) and choose a game you want to dump
quickstart_fagdec_step_open_decrypted: Hover over your game's folder and press △ then choose Open decrypted
quickstart_fagdec_step_copy: Now copy everything inside the game's folder and paste it in a folder of your choosing
quickstart_fagdec_note_selfs: That's the game files done, now we need to use FAGDec to decrypt the selfs.
quickstart_fagdec_step_launch: Launch FAGDec and scroll down until you find the game you want to dump
quickstart_fagdec_step_decrypt_all: Hover on the game and press the ✖ button, wait for FAGDec to find all the modules and then select DECRYPT ALL
quickstart_fagdec_step_start: You will see that the modules have been listed on the right side of the screen. Now go back to the main menu and press Start
quickstart_fagdec_step_start_decrypt: You will see two options here, select the one that says [START] START DECRYPT(SELF)
quickstart_fagdec_step_wait: Now just wait until it finishes decrypting the game modules
quickstart_fagdec_step_output: You can find the output files in ux0:FAGDec/app/'title_id'
quickstart_fagdec_note_merge: Now all you gotta do is take the files that FAGDec outputted and put them in the previously copied folder from VitaShell, if asked to replace some files, confirm the replacement.
quickstart_fagdec_note_title_id: It's very important that the folder containing the game files be named as the game's Title ID. Otherwise your game won't boot.
quickstart_vpk_desc: After dumping your game, you can optionally package it into a .vpk file for Vita3K to install. By packaging your dump into a .vpk, you can drag and drop it directly into the Vita3K window to install it.
quickstart_vpk_step_download: Download VitaOrganizer and run the application on your PC.
quickstart_vpk_step_select: Select the EBOOT.BIN file inside of your dump folder.
quickstart_vpk_note_progress: The progress of the vpk creation will be shown at the bottom of the VitaOrganizer window. Once it's completed, open Vita3K and drag the vpk onto the Vita3K window.
quickstart_nonpdrm_step_download: Download Vitashell and install it to your PS Vita
quickstart_nonpdrm_step_plugin:
Download the latest nonpdrm.skprx, copy it to ux0:tai and modify the ux0:tai/config.txt file to add the path to the module under *KERNEL as follows
*KERNEL
ux0:tai/nonpdrm.skprx
Don't forget to reboot your device, otherwise the plugin will have no effect yet. If you know what you are doing, you may change this path to an arbitrary location as long as it matches the exact location of the module. You may also edit the ur0:tai/config.txt instead assuming you do not have a config.txt file inside the ux0:tai/ folder
quickstart_nonpdrm_step_license:
Now you have to generate a license key. In order to generate a fake license file containing the application's rif key, you must first launch the application with the NoNpDrm plugin enabled. The fake licenses for the applications will then be stored at
ux0:nonpdrm/license/app/TITLE_ID/6488b73b912a753a492e2714e9b38bc7.rif
ux0:nonpdrm/license/addcont/TITLE_ID/DLC_FOLDER/6488b73b912a753a492e2714e9b38bc7.rif (for additional content)
quickstart_nonpdrm_step_transfer:
Transfer the content of gro0:app/TITLE_ID or ux0:app/TITLE_ID to your PC and copy the fake license ux0:nonpdrm/license/app/TITLE_ID/6488b73b912a753a492e2714e9b38bc7.rif file as TITLE_ID/sce_sys/package/work.bin
You need to overwrite the original work.bin
quickstart_nonpdrm_step_zip: Go inside of the TITLE_ID, select all the contents and compress them into a .zip format.
quickstart_nonpdrm_step_install: Open Vita3K, click on the File entry in the menubar and click Install .vpk/.zip. Select your TITLE_ID.zip file and confirm. The game will begin installing (This might take a long time for large games).
quickstart_nonpdrm_dlc_step_copy:
You can also install DLC from ux0:addcont/TITLE_ID/DLC_FOLDER or, on selected card games, from grw0:addcont/TITLE_ID/DLC_FOLDER (ONE AT A TIME)
To do so, copy the fake license ux0:nonpdrm/license/addcont/TITLE_ID/DLC_FOLDER/6488b73b912a753a492e2714e9b38bc7.rif to DLC_FOLDER/sce_sys/package/work.bin and transfer it to your pc.
You need to overwrite the original work.bin.
quickstart_nonpdrm_dlc_step_zip: Go inside of the DLC_FOLDER, select all the contents and compress them into a .zip format.
quickstart_nonpdrm_dlc_step_install: Open Vita3K, click on the File entry in the menubar and click Install .vpk/.zip. Select your DLC_FOLDER.zip file and confirm. The DLC will begin installing.

compatibility_emulator_undergoing_change:
The emulator is currently undergoing great changes of its backend which are greatly improving compatibility with games.
This compatibility list doesn't reflect the state of the emulator anymore and everyone interested in the emulator is
encouraged to re-test their games with the latest emulator builds every few weeks to update the compatibility reports.
compatibility_nothing_desc: Games that don't boot at all, not displaying an initial black screen with an FPS counter.
compatibility_bootable_desc: Games that boot but display nothing more than a black screen with an FPS counter.
compatibility_intro_desc: Games that display any image on screen but doesn't reach to menus.
compatibility_menu_desc: Games that get into menu but can't enter into gameplay.
compatibility_ingame_minus_desc: Games that go into gameplay but have major issues that prevent it from going further early on.
compatibility_ingame_plus_desc: Games that go far into gameplay but have glitches that render the game unplayable or have non-playable performance.
compatibility_playable_desc: Games that can be played from start to finish with playable performance and no game breaking glitches.
compatibility_failed_to_load: Compatibility data could not be loaded right now.
compatibility_no_results: No games match that search in the current view.
compatibility_choose_region_help: Select the regional compatibility report you want to open.
error_page_not_found_desc: The page you are looking for does not exist.
